why: I checked all five expect lines and their proofs. Each one can be checked at the PR head before merge, and each gives a single clear answer. Lines 1–3 come with node -e commands that use Object.is or === and exit 0 or 1, for example "process.exit(Object.is(r,0)?0:1)". Line 4 is "`npm test` exits 0 at the PR head". Line 5 means reading the test file and then running `git show <base>:math.js > math.js` plus `npm test` in a scratch copy. That only needs the merge base, which exists before merge. No line depends on a release, a deploy, a published page or anything else that only exists after merge. Publishing a new version is listed under non-goals, so it isn't something to check. Each proof is a way to check its line at the head.
